ev.q: A case-case analysis was performed comparing exposure frequencies for all food items included in the Listeria Initiative questionnaire
Review of reported exposures indicated that all three patients had consumed prepackaged caramel apples
All patients were hospitalized for listeriosis
Caramel apple consumption was significantly higher among patients included in the outbreak, compared with that among patients with sporadic illnesses
CDC, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA), and state and local health departments initiated a multistate investigation
